Torrential Rain Causes Severe Flooding in Eastern Spain

Torrential rain has caused severe flooding in towns across eastern Spain, trapping residents and leading to widespread evacuations. More than 2,000 people have been evacuated from the region as the downpour batters the area. The heavy rainfall has resulted in towns being submerged.
